grammar_title: 不定式作主语(The Infinitive as the Subject)
source: 人教版2019选择性必修三 Unit 2 Discovering Useful Structures:不定式作主语(直接作主语谓语用单数 / it 作形式主语真正主语后置 / It takes/costs/requires…to do · It is + n. + to do)。句子地道、健康生活主题、答案唯一(只有不定式能作主语,doing/done/that 从句均不成立)。

points.point: 不定式直接作主语,谓语用单数
points.overview: To do sth 直接放句首作主语时,谓语动词用单数(is/keeps/takes…)。如 To exercise regularly keeps us fit. 干扰项 doing/done 等不能与后面的单数谓语自然搭配,过去分词/原形更不能作主语。

points.point: it 作形式主语,不定式真正主语后置
points.overview: 当不定式作主语较长时,常用 it 作形式主语放句首,把真正的主语(to do)后置:It is + adj. + to do。如 It is important to eat a balanced diet.

points.point: It takes/costs/requires…to do · It is + n. + to do
points.overview: 固定句式:It takes/costs/requires (sb) + 时间/精力/钱 + to do;It is + 名词(a good idea / a pity…) + to do。真正主语都是后置的不定式。如 It takes courage to change.

questions.stem: ____ regularly keeps us fit and full of energy.
questions.explanation: 句首作主语、后接单数谓语 keeps,用不定式 To exercise;过去分词/原形/单数动词都不能作主语。

questions.stem: ____ up smoking takes a great deal of willpower.
questions.explanation: 作主语、谓语 takes 为单数,用不定式 To give up;其余形式不能作主语。

questions.stem: ____ a balanced diet is the key to staying healthy.
questions.explanation: 句首作主语、谓语 is 单数,用 To eat;过去分词/动词形式不能作主语。

questions.stem: ____ a bad habit early is much easier than changing it later.
questions.explanation: 作主语、谓语 is,用不定式 To recognise。

questions.stem: ____ breakfast every morning often makes teenagers feel dizzy.
questions.explanation: 句首主语、谓语 makes 单数,用 To skip。

questions.stem: ____ enough sleep helps your body and mind recover.
questions.explanation: 作主语、谓语 helps 单数,用不定式 To get。

questions.stem: ____ stress in a healthy way takes time and practice.
questions.explanation: 作主语、谓语 takes,用 To manage。

questions.stem: ____ a negative routine with a positive one really works.
questions.explanation: 作主语、谓语 works,用不定式 To replace。

questions.stem: ____ the stairs instead of the escalator burns more calories.
questions.explanation: 句首主语、谓语 burns 单数,用 To take。

questions.stem: ____ your bad habit cycle is the first step to changing it.
questions.explanation: 作主语、谓语 is 单数,用不定式 To examine。

questions.stem: ____ to a fitness consultant for advice often saves a lot of trouble.
questions.explanation: 作主语、谓语 saves 单数,用 To turn。

questions.stem: ____ too much sugar damages both your teeth and your health.
questions.explanation: 作主语、谓语 damages 单数,用不定式 To eat。

questions.stem: ____ passive cigarette smoke protects your lungs from harm.
questions.explanation: 句首主语、谓语 protects 单数,用 To avoid。

questions.stem: ____ a few warm-ups before exercise prevents many injuries.
questions.explanation: 作主语、谓语 prevents 单数,用不定式 To do。

questions.stem: ____ small changes every day makes your lifestyle healthier.
questions.explanation: 作主语、谓语 makes 单数,用 To make。

questions.stem: ____ junk food too often leads to serious health problems.
questions.explanation: 作主语、谓语 leads 单数,用不定式 To eat。

questions.stem: ____ your mind off everything else helps you relax completely.
questions.explanation: 句首主语、谓语 helps 单数,用 To take。

questions.stem: ____ a new healthy hobby keeps your mind active and happy.
questions.explanation: 作主语、谓语 keeps 单数,用不定式 To pick up。

questions.stem: ____ a step-by-step plan works better than changing everything at once.
questions.explanation: 作主语、谓语 works 单数,用 To follow。

questions.stem: ____ the neighbours with loud music late at night is rather rude.
questions.explanation: 作主语、谓语 is 单数,用不定式 To disturb。

questions.stem: It is important ____ a balanced diet if you want to stay healthy.
questions.explanation: it 作形式主语,真正主语后置用不定式 to eat;动名词不与 it 形式主语搭配,that 从句结构不成立。

questions.stem: It is hard ____ a bad habit that has lasted for years.
questions.explanation: it 为形式主语,真正主语用 to break。

questions.stem: It is necessary ____ what you eat before you go on a diet.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语 → to check 作真正主语。

questions.stem: It is useful ____ to a doctor for advice on your health.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语 → to turn 真正主语。

questions.stem: It is essential ____ harmful habits from controlling your life.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语 → to stop 真正主语。

questions.stem: It is wise ____ junk food with fruit and nuts.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语 → to replace 真正主语。

questions.stem: It is dangerous ____ drugs of any kind, even just once.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语 → to take 真正主语。

questions.stem: It is healthy ____ at least thirty minutes every day.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语 → to exercise 真正主语。

questions.stem: It is not easy ____ a bad habit quickly, so be patient.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语 → to change 真正主语。

questions.stem: It is harmful ____ breakfast just to save a little time.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语 → to skip 真正主语。

questions.stem: It is helpful ____ a comedy when you feel stressed out.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语 → to watch 真正主语。

questions.stem: It is sensible ____ enough water throughout the day.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语 → to drink 真正主语。

questions.stem: It is wrong ____ your neighbours with noise so late at night.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语 → to disturb 真正主语。

questions.stem: It is silly ____ that one magic pill will cure every bad habit.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语 → to think 真正主语。

questions.stem: It is smart ____ the stairs instead of riding the escalator.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语 → to take 真正主语。

questions.stem: It is foolish ____ that sugary drinks are good for your teeth.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语 → to believe 真正主语。

questions.stem: It is important ____ some discipline when you try to change.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语 → to show 真正主语。

questions.stem: It is best ____ a solution to stress as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语 → to find 真正主语。

questions.stem: It is normal ____ pessimistic after failing the first time.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语 → to feel 真正主语。

questions.stem: It is possible ____ yourself for the better, one small step at a time.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语 → to change 真正主语。

questions.stem: It takes a lot of courage ____ a habit you have had for years.
questions.explanation: It takes + n. + to do;真正主语用不定式 to change。

questions.stem: It took the surgeon three hours ____ my mother's lung surgery.
questions.explanation: It took sb + 时间 + to do,用 to finish。

questions.stem: It is a good idea ____ up a new hobby to fight long-term stress.
questions.explanation: It is + n.(a good idea) + to do,用 to take。

questions.stem: It requires real discipline ____ small changes every single day.
questions.explanation: It requires + n. + to do,用 to make。

questions.stem: It takes willpower ____ smoking once and for all.
questions.explanation: It takes + n. + to do,用 to quit。

questions.stem: It costs nothing ____ for a short walk when you feel stressed.
questions.explanation: It costs + n. + to do,用 to go。

questions.stem: It is a pity ____ such an unhealthy lifestyle at your age.
questions.explanation: It is + n.(a pity) + to do,用 to lead。

questions.stem: It takes patience ____ a bad habit over a period of time.
questions.explanation: It takes + n. + to do,用 to break。

questions.stem: It is a wise choice ____ sugary drinks with plain water.
questions.explanation: It is + n.(a wise choice) + to do,用 to replace。

questions.stem: It requires effort ____ your habit cycle and then adapt it.
questions.explanation: It requires + n. + to do,用 to examine。

questions.stem: It takes only a minute ____ the stairs instead of the escalator.
questions.explanation: It takes + 时间 + to do,用 to climb。

questions.stem: It is a relief ____ free from the stress of exams at last.
questions.explanation: It is + n.(a relief) + to do,用 to feel。

questions.stem: It takes courage ____ no to junk food when everyone is eating it.
questions.explanation: It takes + n. + to do,用 to say。

questions.stem: It costs a lot of money ____ surgery, so it is better to stay healthy.
questions.explanation: It costs + n. + to do,用 to have。

questions.stem: It is a good habit ____ regularly and sleep early every night.
questions.explanation: It is + n.(a good habit) + to do,用 to exercise。

questions.stem: It requires time ____ a new healthy routine until it feels natural.
questions.explanation: It requires + n. + to do,用 to form。

questions.stem: It takes self-control ____ away from your phone before bed.
questions.explanation: It takes + n. + to do,用 to stay。

questions.stem: It is a smart move ____ snacks from home instead of buying sweets.
questions.explanation: It is + n.(a smart move) + to do,用 to bring。

questions.stem: It costs you nothing ____ a comedy and have a good laugh.
questions.explanation: It costs + n. + to do,用 to watch。

questions.stem: It is a real pleasure ____ healthy and full of energy again.
questions.explanation: It is + n.(a real pleasure) + to do,用 to be。
